verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents its own layered work objects (projects, loops, intentions, stories and tasks), and incoming feedback routes to a project and becomes an intention with proposed tasks. That gives requests a place in a product-owned hierarchy, but the evidence never describes features, components or initiatives as levels, or how a PM would restructure requests within them. Missing for 10: explicit feature/component/initiative levels, documented parent-child relationships or reorganization of requests, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can organize requests into a hierarchy of features, components, and initiatives

citations.quote: Projects, loops, intentions, stories and tasks from a terminal
An intention starts from the report, and its agent reads the submission, fills in the intention, and proposes the tasks
Pick a project on that page and submissions route to that project.
